links.outcome: LLM response quality when communicating in Kinyarwanda versus English
links.effect: Performance degraded slightly in Kinyarwanda, but LLMs remained superior to local clinicians and were over 500 times cheaper per response.
links.quote: While performance degraded slightly when LLMs communicated in Kinyarwanda, the LLMs remained superior to clinicians and were over 500 times cheaper per response.

links.outcome: Expert-rated response quality of LLMs versus local clinicians on 11 metrics
links.effect: All LLMs significantly outperformed local clinicians (ps < 0.001) across all metrics; Gemini-2 surpassed local GPs by an average of 0.83 points (range 0.38-1.10).
links.quote: All LLMs significantly outperformed local clinicians (ps < 0.001) across all metrics, with Gemini-2, for example, surpassing local GPs by an average of 0.83 points on every metric (range: 0.38 – 1.10).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating LLM-generated responses against local clinician responses to clinical questions from community health workers in Rwanda.
